insulating clay sheets as second phase fillings were used to tailor conductive porous structure, which resulted in highly sensitive and fast response to organic vapors.

the design and development of a new class of highly sensitive and fast responding organic vapor sensors by tuning porous conductive composite structure using an insulating filler.
the design and development of highly efficient organic vapor sensors based on 3D porous composites.

the design and fabrication of a novel porous conductive composite with excellent mechanical elasticity, acid and alkali resistant properties, and stable electrical properties, as well as highly sensitive and fast response organic vapor sensor.

this work paves a way for design and fabrication of advanced organic vapor sensor with high sensitivity and fast response.

the insulating second phase fillers are very important to tune the conductive porous composites for advanced organic vapor sensors.

the addition of insulating clay can significantly improve the sensitivity and response time of organic vapor sensors based on conductive porous materials.
the insulating second filler can tune the porous conductive structure, and then enhance the sensitivity and response speed of the porous conductive materials for the organic vapor sensor.
